checklist.note: Audited built-in, registered, and custom Validator Designer forms; none expose any input field, dropdown, or toggle for Confidence or Confidence threshold. In custom validator registration, deterministic operations (equals, range, schema, forbidden-content, structural) take rule definitions, not confidence. When confidence keys ('confidence: 0.95', 'confidence_threshold: 0.80') are entered into the Expected YAML text area of a built-in schema validator, the UI places them inside the schema dictionary argument passed to validator 'schema' (evidence://ct-rui-002-builtin-conf-diff.png); they are payload argument data evaluated by the schema checker, not a Confidence value or threshold carried by the Validator itself. Direct authoring of 'confidence: 0.9' or 'confidence_threshold: 0.8' on a Constraint in the Workspace YAML editor is refused by UI preflight checks with 'Volume XV / Volume V: a Validator MUST be deterministic and MUST NOT carry a Confidence value. A model deciding pass/fail is configuring a Judge.' (evidence://ct-rui-002-yaml-confidence-refusal.png, evidence://ct-rui-002-yaml-threshold-refusal.png), blocking Apply and preserving the workspace and engine states unchanged.

checklist.statement: The second is refused or redirected to Judge configuration, with the reason shown.
checklist.note: In the Custom Validator Designer, setting 'Does this check call a model, or any non-deterministic service, to decide pass or fail?' to 'yes' immediately surfaces an explicit refusal message citing Volume XV / Volume V: 'a Validator MUST be deterministic and MUST NOT carry a Confidence value. A model deciding pass/fail is configuring a Judge.' (evidence://ct-rui-002-model-yes-refusal.png). The Review & Apply button is disabled, proposing YAML is blocked, and an actionable redirect link 'Open Judge Configuration with entered draft' is provided, which successfully transitions to the Judge Configuration screen at #judges with draft criteria pre-populated (evidence://ct-rui-002-redirected-to-judge.png). Engine GET responses and workspace SHA-256 before and after confirm nothing was saved.

notes: Verified through automated script capture including direct form audit, payload differentiation testing, direct Constraint YAML authoring, and before/after verification of workspace SHA-256 and read-only engine GET responses.
